description: Authoritative session evidence logging and chunk persistence health enum as defined by Architecture Revision 3 Component C-02.

definitions.STARTING: Recording session initializing, creating directory hierarchy and manifest header.
definitions.HEALTHY: All evidence streams writing, syncing chunks to persistent storage without queue backpressure.
definitions.EVIDENCE_DEGRADED: Queue overflow or non-fatal write delay; some non-mandatory records dropped with explicit loss counters.
definitions.LOW_STORAGE: Storage remaining below critical threshold; chunk rotation restricted and recording transitioning to stop.
definitions.INCOMPLETE: Session interrupted by unhandled crash, power loss, or process recreation; partial chunks recovered.
definitions.COMPLETE: Recording session finalized cleanly with manifest closed, checksum verified, and ZIP export ready.
